extraction.Name: Mrs. Louisa Dougherty (Mother & Heir of Dolly Dougherty, deceased)
extraction.Refused/Protested: do not know if Patent was accepted without protest
extraction.Recorded patent: Filed for record January 20, 1920, in volume 167, page 47, at Court House, Hughes Co., Pierre, S. Dak. It is known by whom it was filed.
